verification.command:
python3 - <<'LABEX_CHECK'
import os,pathlib,shutil,subprocess,tempfile
p=pathlib.Path('/home/labex/project/array-comparison.sh')
assert p.is_file(), 'Create the requested file first'
text=p.read_text()
assert all(token in text for token in ['a=(3 5 8 10 6)', 'b=(6 5 4 12)', 'c=(14 7 5 7)']), 'Required concepts missing'
if False: assert os.access(p,os.X_OK), 'Add execute permission'
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='labex-shell-check-') as directory:
    work=pathlib.Path(directory)
    source=p
    if p.suffix == '.sh':
        p=work/source.name
        # Preserve teaching delays in the learner file; suppress sleep only in
        # this isolated behavior probe so a five-second loop does not time out.
        p.write_text(text if False else text.replace('sleep 1', ':').replace('sleep 2', ':'))
        p.chmod(0o700)
        assert subprocess.run(['/bin/bash','-n',str(p)],capture_output=True).returncode == 0
    def execute(arguments, data=''):
        return subprocess.run(['/bin/bash',*arguments],input=data,text=True,capture_output=True,cwd=work,timeout=2)
    result=execute([str(p),*[]],'')
    assert all(item in result.stdout for item in []),result.stdout
LABEX_CHECK

sections.title: Implement the first comparison loop
sections.title_vi: Viết vòng lặp so sánh thứ nhất
sections.content:
Collect shared values of a and b into z using nested loops.

`~/project/array-comparison.sh`:

```bash
#!/bin/bash
a=(3 5 8 10 6)
b=(6 5 4 12)
c=(14 7 5 7)
z=()
for x in "${a[@]}"; do
  for y in "${b[@]}"; do
    if [ "$x" = "$y" ]; then z+=("$x"); fi
  done
done
echo "Common elements between a and b: ${z[@]}"
```

Run:

```bash
bash ~/project/array-comparison.sh 
```

sections.title_vi: Viết vòng lặp so sánh thứ hai
sections.content:
Compare c with z and store their shared values in j.

`~/project/array-comparison.sh`:

```bash
#!/bin/bash
a=(3 5 8 10 6)
b=(6 5 4 12)
c=(14 7 5 7)
z=()
for x in "${a[@]}"; do
  for y in "${b[@]}"; do
    if [ "$x" = "$y" ]; then z+=("$x"); fi
  done
done
echo "Common elements between a and b: ${z[@]}"
j=()
for i in "${c[@]}"; do
  for k in "${z[@]}"; do
    if [ "$i" = "$k" ]; then j+=("$i"); fi
  done
done
echo "Common elements among a, b, and c: ${j[@]}"
```

Run:

```bash
bash ~/project/array-comparison.sh 
```
